definition: the rounded back part of the foot
description: In a gym with a wooden floor, a finger points in close-up at a foot in a navy sock that has a thin stiletto spike fixed under the rounded back part of the foot, so the sock stands on a heel with no shoe around it. The camera pulls back to show three people in matching navy gym shirts trying to walk across the floor on these spikes, arms held out for balance, wobbling and laughing, one man in shorts leading and a woman and an older man following behind him.

en.question: What are the three people doing?

de.answer: Sie versuchen, auf Stilettoabsätzen zu gehen.
de.question: Was machen die drei Leute?

es.answer: Están intentando caminar con tacones de aguja.
es.question: ¿Qué están haciendo las tres personas?

fr.answer: Elles essaient de marcher avec des talons aiguilles.
fr.question: Que font les trois personnes ?
